preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of nodes in the tree is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of nodes in your subtree is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The number of nodes in Li Chen's subtree is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: Output is either -1 or a single integer between 1 and n, inclusive.
postconditions.description: The output should indicate the presence or absence of a common vertex between the two subtrees, and if present, the label of one such vertex.

invariants.expression: The tree is a connected graph with n nodes and n-1 edges.
invariants.description: The input tree is a valid tree with no cycles and exactly n-1 edges.

invariants.expression: The subtrees are connected subgraphs of the tree.
invariants.description: The subtrees are connected subgraphs formed by the specified nodes and their edges.

invariants.expression: The number of questions asked is at most 5.
invariants.description: You can ask at most 5 questions to determine the common vertex or conclude that there is none.
